goal: Retained exact own-output unseen four-operation and bounded mixed arithmetic ability per external sample and actual compute, learned from real byte feedback without supplied arithmetic rules

elm.claim: Operational exclusion; the two technical worlds are not a statistical impossibility proof of the whole family.

feedback.warmup: The learner may observe the expected output bytes and its end marker as real training feedback.
feedback.transition: Expected outputs may become sporadic or imperfect, with the received observation/provenance explicit. Exact transition and corruption model are not locked.
feedback.terminal: Only a scalar 0/1 judgement of the learner's complete generated response; no hidden answer-byte, numeric-error or intermediate-result loss.
feedback.joint_design: Co-design model state, credit assignment and feedback curriculum. Do not assume an architecture change alone or a weaker feedback stream alone resolves acquisition.
feedback.current_source_cell_training_fact: Every permitted W record already used real expected reply bytes and EOS in cross-entropy; absence of supervised answers cannot explain this preparation's poor acquisition.

next_design_basis.reference: Faithful old ANSWER-0 recurrent source, retained as a reference rather than an adopted new arithmetic core.
next_design_basis.hypothesis: A learned prompt-preservation path and separate evolving generation state may improve information access and credit; no successful repair is yet established.
controls_needed: Continuous expected-output feedback under the same problem stream
Warmup-matched frozen learning during the later 0/1 phase
count_separately: All problem presentations, including warmup and replay
Actual training, exploration and generation compute
next_design_basis.selection_and_curriculum: Tune only on development/training information, keep held-out relation groups absent from all warmup and later feedback, freeze finite budgets before confirmation.
next_design_basis.primary_evaluation: Retained exact own-output generalization to unseen four-operation/mixed cases across the full sample and compute history, plus improvement during the scalar-feedback phase.

evidence.external_limit: Learning to Execute reports teacher-forced accuracy and uses a substantially larger LSTM; it is not a matched own-output feasibility result for this core.
